title: Tutor
description: See the shape of a phrase. Compare MIDI dynamics, onset timing and key-hold duration with a reference lesson, then review how the three components evolve across the score. A visual aid for practice, not an automatic musical judgement.
people: Based on an idea by Jura Margulis
previewAlt: Schematic isometric feedback cube with coloured traces; illustrative, not measured performance data.
